title: Forest Biometrics Tools (Ormancılık Biyometrisi Araçları)
description:
Browser-based tools for forest inventory and biometrics data, published at forestbiometry.online: Forest Data Checker, Plot & Stand Metrics, Model Evaluation, Diameter Distribution Lab (Weibull, normal, lognormal, gamma, fixed-bound beta, Johnson SB, exponential and log-logistic; direct fitting, measurement thresholds, grouped data, parameter recovery after Poudel and Cao (2013) and Parresol (2003), model comparison and bootstrap uncertainty), Height–Diameter Modelling, Inventory Sampling Planner and Relative Ranking.

Data stay in the user's browser; the server keeps no user data. Every scientific calculation is tested against an independent reference (SciPy, NumPy, mpmath, scikit-learn or hand-computed cases); tests and reference generators are included. Interface in Turkish and English; project documentation in Turkish.

Each tool carries its own version; the release notes list the version of every tool in this release.
